disambiguation: Not a full IDE; it is a bridge allowing the Pi Coding Agent to interact with Obsidian content.
extras: Desktop-only plugin relying on local WebSocket server and Pi Coding Agent.
intentEvidence: Connect Obsidian to Pi Coding Agent through the pi-ide protocol.
problem: It addresses the need for an AI agent (Pi) to interact with and modify content within the Obsidian note-taking environment.

relations.evidence: Connect Obsidian to Pi Coding Agent through the pi-ide protocol.

summary: Pi IDE connects Obsidian to the Pi Coding Agent using a local WebSocket protocol, allowing the agent to view the current file, cursor, and selection for editing tasks.
